# samples: protocolbuffers/protobuf/39550723836-119059086397
# bazel 经典错误头: 行首 `ERROR: ` 前缀的两类高特异形态 —
# ① `ERROR: <path>:<row>:<col>: <msg>` (规则/目标求值失败, 如 repository fetch 失败的 Traceback 头);
# ② `ERROR: no such (package|target|rule|label)` (external 仓库解析失败)。
# 锚刻意收紧到这两形态而非裸 `ERROR: ` — pip 的 `ERROR: pip's dependency resolver ...`
# 依赖冲突警告在成功 job 常见 (fmtlib 39574123266 实测), 裸前缀会误吸。
# ext loop: 3 空格/tab 缩进续行 (Starlark `   Traceback` / `\tFile "...", line N` / `\t\tdownload_info = ...`),
# `Error in download: ...` 无缩进根因行不被吞 (ERROR 锚行自身即签名, 根因行紧邻下一个块或闭块边界)。
id: bazel-error
title: 'bazel 错误头 (ERROR: path:row:col / ERROR: no such ...) + Starlark Traceback 缩进树'
tool: bazel
category: build
confidence: high
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(ERROR: \S+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: |ERROR: no such (package|target|rule|label)[ :])'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(   |\t)\S'
    loop: true
kind: signal
attribution:
  contributor: luochen1990
  generated-by: {harness: opencode-agent, model: glm-5.3}
  adapter-version: 0.1.0

  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(\s{2,}\S|\})'

# samples: sst/opencode/38846192625-116797151353
# bun test 失败用例标记行 (`(fail) <name> [duration]`, 与 `(pass)` 对偶)。
# 单行块 + context.after=3 带出空行/所属测试文件/失败消息首行 (仅扩输出);
# 紧随其后的 `N pass / N fail / Ran N tests` 汇总区与 bun-script-exit-fail 锚自然衔接 (A5 合并)。
id: bun-test-fail
title: bun test 失败用例行 ((fail) name [duration])
tool: bun
category: test
confidence: high
context: {before: 0, after: 3}
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?\(fail\) '
kind: signal

# samples: haskell/cabal/39521726012-118968266826, haskell/cabal/39348168469-118387142016, haskell/haskell-language-server/39476330432-118813201488, haskell/haskell-language-server/39191160143-117864106802, haskell/cabal/39144143826-117724435998 (+9 同形态样本)
# 锚: cabal-install 结构化错误头 `Error: [Cabal-<code>]` — `[Cabal-N]` 码段是 cabal 独有签名,
# 与 stack 的 `[S-N]` 词法面不相交。实测码: 7107 (依赖解析失败, 首细节 `Could not resolve
# dependencies:` + `[__N] trying/rejecting/skipping:` 回跳链) / 7125 (构建失败, 首细节 `Failed to
# (`Could not resolve dependencies:` 等 col-0 行)。扩展 = `[^\s0-9#]` 首字符约束: 非-TS 回溯路径
# 不可能吃进时间戳行 (行首恒为数字), TS-only 空白行闭块; `#` 排除平台注解/分组行 (`##[error]`)
# 被吞入错误块。跨空白的续段 (7107 回跳链内分段) 不追 — 锚行码段+首段已携带根因; 以数字开头的
# 细节行 (罕见) 同样闭块。category: 多因混合 (7107=deps / 7125=build), 按打标纪律宁缺勿错 → unknown。
id: cabal-structured-error
title: 'cabal 结构化错误头 (Error: [Cabal-xxxx] + 细节链)'
tool: cabal
category: unknown
intent: failure
confidence: high
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?Error: \[Cabal-[0-9]+\]'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?\s*[^\s0-9#]'
    loop: true
kind: signal
attribution:
  contributor: lc (agent-drafted, opencode/GLM)
  generated-by: { harness: opencode, model: glm-5.3 }
  adapter-version: p3-wave1

# samples: niri-wm/niri/38707552842-116330622870 (正向锚), django/django/39535409436-119010803789, gradle/gradle/39541783022-119030943685, tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/39281027929-118155018623 (负向锚: 后三者命中过旧锚的跨栈行, 新锚须不命中)
# cargo 依赖下载/编译进度行 — 高频噪音。P3 Wave0 收窄 (跨栈过匹配修复):
# 旧锚 `(Compiling|Downloaded|Downloading|Updating|Unpacking|Fresh)` + 任意缩进容忍, 在首刷
# 110 仓语料上命中 107 仓 — 吞掉非 cargo 生态的同词头行: pip `Downloading *.whl`、apt
# `Unpacking <pkg> (...)`、git checkout `Updating files: N%`、freebsd pkg `Downloading [N]`/
# `Updating FreeBSD repository...`、docker `Status: Downloaded ...`、甚至 Django 测试用例名
# `Updating a field of a model subclass ... ok` (信号行被噪规则吞 = FN 风险)。
# 新锚 = cargo 输出的两个结构不变量 (语料全量枚举证实, 见 PR 描述):
#   1. 动词右对齐 12 列 (indent+动词长度恒 12): `   Compiling` / `  Downloaded` /
#      ` Downloading` / `    Updating` / `      Fresh`; 其他包管理器同词头行均不满足
#      (pip 0/2 缩进, uv 1 缩进 `Downloaded`, git/freebsd 0 缩进);
#   2. 动词后接 cargo 专属尾缀: `<crate> v<semver>` (Compiling/Downloaded/Fresh)、
#      `crates.io`/`git repository ` (Updating)、`crates` (Downloading)。
# ANSI 容忍保留实测形态: 色码在缩进前 (`\x1b[1m\x1b[92m   Compiling\x1b[0m crate vN`),
# 故 ANSI 组在 indent+动词单元两侧。`Unpacking` 移除 — cargo 不产此行 (apt 专属)。
id: cargo-progress-noise
title: cargo 进度噪音行 (Compiling/Downloaded/Downloading/Updating/Fresh, 12 列对齐 + cargo 尾缀锚定)
tool: cargo
confidence: low
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(?:\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)*(?:(   Compiling|  Downloaded|      Fresh)(?:\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)* \S+ v[0-9]|    Updating(?:\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)* (crates\.io|git repository )| Downloading(?:\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)* crates)'
kind: noise
attribution:
  contributor: lc (agent-drafted, opencode/GLM)
  generated-by: { harness: opencode, model: glm-5.3 }
  adapter-version: p3-wave0

# samples: google/benchmark/37714285616-113781433420, google/benchmark/37918829126-113781670082, google/benchmark/39244525244-118046179465
# 锚: DoozyX/clang-format-lint-action 的漂移报告头 `--- <path>\t(original)` — (original)/(reformatted)
# label 是该 action 专属形态 (clang-format --output-replacements-xml 之外的 diff 输出), 普通 git
# diff 的 `--- a/file` 无 label 不冲突。FN 诊断 §1: JS action 退出即败不产注解, diff 即唯一证据。
# 扩展 (有序): `+++ <path> (reformatted)` → `@@` hunk → diff 体 (ANSI 色码容忍, 行首 [-+ ] 或 @@;
# 体行含 hunk 自身, 多 hunk/多文件连续吸收)。与 telescope stylua 的 `Diff in <file>:` 形态锚不同,
# 按特异锚分立 (族级抽象的取舍: 分)。
id: clang-format-lint-diff
title: 'clang-format 漂移 diff 块 (--- path (original) / +++ (reformatted) + ANSI diff 体)'
tool: clang-format
category: fmt
confidence: high
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)*--- \S.*\(original\)[ \t]*$'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)*\+\+\+ \S.*\(reformatted\)[ \t]*$'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)*@@ -[0-9]+(,[0-9]+)? \+[0-9]+(,[0-9]+)? @@'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(\x1b\[[0-9;]*m)*([-+ ]|@@)'
    loop: true
kind: signal
attribution:
  contributor: luochen1990
  generated-by: {harness: opencode-agent, model: glm-5.3}
  adapter-version: 0.1.0

# samples: bitcoin/bitcoin/39419195723-118615614767, neovim/neovim/39498802072-118891310509, swiftlang/swift/39502997228-118904871567
# 锚: cmake configure 期错误头 `CMake Error at <file>:<line> (<command>):` — 语料全形态皆带
# `at ... (cmd):` 后缀 (message / cmake_minimum_required 等); Windows 路径 (D:/a/...) 与 Unix
